The Gordie Howe International Bridge opens today! This morning, I got behind the wheel of a Michigan-built Ford Mustang to mark the official opening. 
 
I fought to open this bridge to build the economy and connect Michiganders to opportunities on both sides of the Detroit River.

Every Michigander deserves a quality, affordable place to call home.
  
That’s why I'm delivering on my promise to expand housing opportunity. Today, I signed a new bipartisan housing budget that cuts red tape, lowers housing costs, and makes more homes available to families.

state-local-politics.quote:
Since my first day in office, protecting Michiganders has been a top priority.

Yesterday, I was proud to reinforce this commitment with a series of bills that support first responders and expand emergency alert systems - because everyone deserves to be safe here in Michigan.

Over the last 7.5 years, I’ve been proud to fight for the things that make a real difference for Michiganders.
   
More jobs. Good roads. Reduced costs. Increased opportunity.
   
Today, I'm proud to build on this work by signing my eighth and final balanced, bipartisan budget.

When I took office 7.5 years ago, growing Michigan’s economy responsibly was one of my top priorities.

Fast forward to 2026, and I’ve now signed 8 balanced, bipartisan budgets that have set Michigan up for a brighter future. Here’s why that matters. 👇

Together we've improved upon the state’s fiscal record by increasing the rainy-day fund, paying down debt, and strengthening Michigan’s credit rating.

Plus, we've invested in our schools, grown our economy, and lowered costs for Michiganders.
After 8 budgets, we’re leaving Michigan’s finances better than we found them.
